reviews.rationale: The survey supports serious limitations in ordinary prompted self-correction, while documenting successful correction under external feedback and fine-tuning. Thus the limitation holds in some settings, but categorical inability does not. The contract's unaided-only restriction would obscure this distinction; the resourcefulness inference is not separately established.
